capabilities: start native OS file drags from the file explorer via Electron's webContents.startDrag
expose the real on-disk file path instead of an obsidian:// URL
trigger external drags with a configurable modifier key (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or none)
drag multiple selected files at once
log resolved filesystem paths for debugging
disambiguation: Only covers dragging files out of Obsidian to other apps; it does not change how files are dropped into the vault.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin marketplace; manual installation from release assets is required. Desktop only (isDesktopOnly), tested mostly on Windows; macOS and Linux are less tested, and cloud placeholders like OneDrive files may need to download before the target app can use them.
intentEvidence: Drag Out intercepts file-tree drags when your configured modifier key is held
problem: Dragging a note from Obsidian's file tree hands other apps an obsidian:// link rather than the on-disk file, so browser upload fields, email attachments, and file managers reject it.

relations.evidence: uses Electron's webContents.startDrag API to expose the real on-disk file path

summary: Modifier-key drag helper that lets you drag files from the file explorer into other apps as real filesystem files instead of obsidian:// URLs.
